§6Rubber§f

§aSynthetic polymer that replaces latex in every recipe  -  automation and nuclear power depend on it!§f

Rubber is made from §bUnsaturated Hydrocarbons§f and §bSulfur§f in the §bChemical Plant§f. Recipe: §e500mB§f Unsaturated Hydrocarbons + Sulfur yields §e1×§f Rubber Bar.

§6Why it matters§f:
§b•§f Replaces Latex in all recipes.
§b•§f Way easier to automate than tapping rubber trees.
§b•§f Conveyor Belts: 64 per batch for item transport.
§b•§f Pneumatic Tubes: 8-24 per batch for automation.
§b•§f ZIRNOX Nuclear Reactor: 16 Rubber Bars required.
§b•§f Improved armor and hazmat suits.

§6Alternate recipes§f exist in the Ore Acidizer (Sour Gas + Latex, or Cadmium + Fish Oil) but the Chemical Plant method is the easiest to automate.

§ePS:§f You will need thousands of rubber for a conveyor-based factory. Set up Unsaturated Hydrocarbon production from your cracked oil line and keep it flowing!
